title: Browser evidence reads
responsibility: Use the project permission guard for evidence and verified artifact requests.

inputs.name: browserEvidenceReads.api
inputs.description: API client used for JSON evidence and bounded media reads.

inputs.name: browserEvidenceReads.guard
inputs.description: Guard that resolves the project base path and handles permission failures.

outputs.name: browserEvidenceReads
outputs.description: evidence and artifact bridge methods using public evidence fields; artifact additionally validates returned media against the requested hash.
